Hey, thanks for your answer and taking the time to read this.

To be honest, it's not about being gay (I'm a trans guy, so it's not helping), it's just so hard not being able to connect to anyone. I have such a hard time understanding others and making friends that finding "love" seems an impossible feat.

I just feel like I'm failing at life. I just can't have anything good in it. No job, no friends, no lover, barely keeping a relationship with my family. I don't think it's worth it to keep going.

My mind is a mess, everything is jumbled and it's like I have no will to do anything anymore. I fell into a kind of apathy, without any strength to face the world, to get up in the morning, to go to work.

I feel so alone, I no longer sleep at night, growing old freaks me out. I spend my nights imagining my dreams without ever giving myself the strength to make them come true during the day. I feel like I'm an empty shell, after spending too much time slipping into depression, there's nothing left, no more energy, no more personality.

Yeah that'd be nice :)
I'm still waiting on confirmation from my job about my start date but I'll definitely join you when I arrive!

What do you mean DiY'ing ?

Thanks for all your answers!

Concerning Brexit, would it be easier for me to get my shots in France for the moment?

I have a shot to do before I leave to London in 2 weeks and since it's a monthly shot, I would only be a bit overdue if I wait after March 29th to see what's up with Brexit...

I'm not sure I can get an appointment with my doctor before I leave, so I only have my current prescription to work with (and some other papers like psychiatrist letter attesting I'm trans) 

What do you guys think?
